concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-recurring-article-email-notifications]] - article-level customer email route for First Decline, automatic First Retry, Second Retry and configurable Past Due timing, limited to events that leave the subscription `Past Due`; includes authorized-signer Support activation and Control Panel configuration, and remains distinct from sale/refund receipts and subscription webhooks.
warnings: Preserve the condition that emails are sent only for events leaving the subscription in `Past Due`; do not present every listed event as unconditionally generating an email.
Preserve the cancellation example: cancellation after the second retry yields no Second Retry email and no automatic cancellation notification in the article's stated scenario.
Keep transaction/refund Email Receipts, recurring-billing customer emails and subscription webhooks as separate evidence routes; this article establishes no API or webhook behavior.
Retain the authorized-signer Support activation prerequisite and do not substitute the Control Panel Account Admin role.
